phase: Phase 1 completed before any rule/source edit

bottle.reason: 清空且清洁的塑料饮料瓶属于可回收的废塑料。
bottle.enReason: An empty, clean plastic beverage bottle is recyclable plastic.
bottle.disposalGuide: 清空内容物并保持清洁干燥，投放可回收物收集容器。
bottle.enDisposalGuide: Empty the bottle, keep it clean and dry, and use the recyclables container.
bottle.matchCondition: One empty clean plastic beverage bottle, clearly plastic; no chemicals, mixed materials or obvious heavy contamination.

can.reason: 清空且清洁的金属饮料罐属于可回收的废金属。
can.enReason: An empty, clean metal beverage can is recyclable metal.
can.disposalGuide: 清空内容物并保持清洁干燥，投放可回收物收集容器。
can.enDisposalGuide: Empty the can, keep it clean and dry, and use the recyclables container.
can.matchCondition: One empty clean metal beverage can; not an aerosol or chemical container.

box.reason: 清洁干燥、未被油污污染的纸箱属于可回收纸类。
box.enReason: Clean, dry cardboard without oil contamination is recyclable paper.
box.disposalGuide: 清空纸箱，保持清洁干燥，投放可回收物收集容器。
box.enDisposalGuide: Empty the box, keep it clean and dry, and use the recyclables container.
box.matchCondition: One clean dry cardboard box without oil, food or mixed-material coating.

banana.reason: 香蕉皮是容易腐烂的瓜果皮，属于厨余垃圾。
banana.enReason: Banana peel is perishable fruit peel and belongs to food waste.
banana.disposalGuide: 沥干水分，去除塑料袋等外包装后投放厨余垃圾。
banana.enDisposalGuide: Drain liquids and remove plastic bags or other packaging before placing in food waste.
banana.matchCondition: One banana peel; no packaging or other mixed waste.

tissue.reason: 被污染的纸巾属于其他垃圾，不作为清洁废纸回收。
tissue.enReason: Contaminated tissue belongs to residual waste rather than clean recyclable paper.
tissue.disposalGuide: 收拢以免散落，投放其他垃圾；医疗废物不在此规则范围内。
tissue.enDisposalGuide: Contain it to prevent scattering and use residual waste; medical waste is outside this rule.
tissue.matchCondition: One clearly used contaminated household tissue, not medical waste or an unidentified wet wipe.

alkaline.reason: 已确认无汞的普通碱性干电池通常按其他垃圾处理，不能推广到所有电池。
alkaline.enReason: Confirmed mercury-free ordinary alkaline dry cells are usually residual waste; this does not apply to all batteries.
alkaline.disposalGuide: 仅适用于确认无汞的普通碱性干电池；类型不明、充电或破损电池请向投放管理人核实。
alkaline.enDisposalGuide: Only for confirmed mercury-free ordinary alkaline dry cells. Ask the sorting manager about unknown, rechargeable or damaged batteries.
alkaline.matchCondition: One intact ordinary non-rechargeable alkaline dry cell with clearly readable alkaline and mercury-free labels; never infer chemistry from shape.
